mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,cancellation_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,cancel_key,original_kind,original_key,original_sha256,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM formal_capability_cancellation WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND original_kind=#{originalKind} AND original_key=#{originalKey} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,cancellation_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,operation_id,cancel_key,original_kind,original_key,original_sha256,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,classification,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM formal_capability_cancellation WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND cancel_key=#{key} LIMIT 2

SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND operation_name='FORMAL-CAPABILITY-CANCEL' AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{cancellationId} AND updated_at=#{createdAt} AND state='COMPLETED' AND http_status=200 AND revision=1 AND error_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} AND created_at=#{createdAt} LIMIT 2

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='formal.capability.request.cancelled' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} AND created_at=#{createdAt} LIMIT 2

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{cancellationId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='formal.capability.request.cancelled' AND occurred_at=#{createdAt} LIMIT 2
